data.name: SummonFall
data.detailed_description:
Build a hero. Summon a warband.


SummonFall is a single-player, summoner-first fantasy horde-survival action RPG. Choose your first summon and a matching weapon, then build around the allies you want fighting at your side.

Move and dodge through top-down arenas while your equipped weapons automatically target nearby enemies. Your summon relic calls allies into battle as its cooldown recovers, growing a small fighting force around your hero.

Survive five minutes. Defeat the boss.


Each floor is a focused five-minute survival challenge. Enemy groups change and intensify as the timer advances. At the five-minute mark, the floor boss arrives—defeat it to unlock the next challenge.

During each attempt:
  • Collect experience and choose temporary upgrades that change your run.
  • Balance damage, defense, movement, summon power, and ultimate strength.
  • Dodge threats and manage your position while weapons and summons attack automatically.

Turn every drop into permanent power


Defeated enemies award experience and Souls and can drop equipment. Equip main and off-hand weapons, armor, jewelry, and a summon relic. Chase higher-ranked drops, strengthen favorite gear with Souls, and invest in Survival, Ultimate, and Summon skill paths.

Your inventory, equipment, skill progression, and unlocked floors persist between sessions, giving every attempt a chance to strengthen the next one.

Play the free demo


The public demo includes Floors 1–3, sequential unlocks, three floor bosses, and save/relaunch support. Reach Floor 3’s victory screen to complete the demo and help shape SummonFall through player feedback.

Demo progress is saved separately. Gameplay progress, Souls/currency, items, and floor unlocks will not transfer to Early Access.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Target: 1920 x 1080, Low settings, 30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
